notes:
Account notes: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary use: augment product support & in-app help with chat, vector search+embeddings for feature discovery, and reranking for search results. Team: CTO (Marin Hale), Product Lead (Sandeep Rao), Eng Manager (Lena Ortiz).

Sales / technical summary: evaluating Hosted API first (good early dev velocity) then moving to Dedicated for predictable latency and volume. Customer explicitly wants Dedicated POC that proves:
- canary deploys w/ traffic split (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and automated rollback on error rate/latency spike
- fallback routing: model-variant fallback (quantized 4-bit variant -> fp16 variant -> cloud-licensed high-capacity model) and region failover (primary NA region -> EU region for EU residency + disaster recovery)
- KPIs: p95 latency target <= 250ms for short chat turns (<= 256 tokens); throughput target ~ 200 concurrent short-chat sessions; embedding batch throughput ~ 1.2M tokens/day; cost-sensitivity: want < 40% uplift vs hosted at scale

Security/compliance notes: SOC2 required; must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration for key rotation, audit logging retention 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers. They asked about on-prem option for air-gapped customers but prefer VPC-enabled Dedicated in cloud for now.

POC scope (agreed tentative): 3-week Dedicated POC — week 0: infra & networking prep (VPC peering, firewall rules); week 1: deploy canary with 'sentry-small' quantized model and run traffic generator; week 2: introduce fallback routing rules and forced failover test to EU region; week 3: rollback drills + quality evals on user prompt set.

Pricing / commercial: discussed committed capacity tiers. CFO wants a clear comparison: hosted vs 12-month Dedicated commit with burst buffer. Pricing doc shared (see drive). CFO flag: needs granular token-level cost estimate per use-case.

Quotes / paraphrases: "We need to be confident we can failover without user-visible regression" — Marin Hale.
